info.title: Avoma Universal API
info.description: Manage Avoma meetings, notes, recordings, and conversation insights

post.description: Creates a new call in Avoma.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

externalId.description: Unique ID of the call from the dialer system.

userEmail.description: Email of the Avoma user who made or received the call.

fromNumber.description: Phone number from which the call was made.

toNumber.description: Phone number to which the call was made.

startAt.description: Start time of the call in ISO 8601 UTC format.

recordingUrl.description: Public URL of the call recording for Avoma to download and process.

direction.description: Direction of the call, for example inbound or outbound.

source.description: Lowercase source of the call, for example ringcentral or twilio.

participants[].email.description: Email address of a participant. The first participant should be the prospect or lead.

subject.description: Subject of the meeting associated with the call.

meetingPurposeUuid.description: UUID of the meeting type associated with the call.

meetingOutcomeUuid.description: UUID of the meeting outcome associated with the call.
